title: God's Beautiful World Quiz
description: Let's see what you remember about God's beautiful creation!

questions.question: Who made all the animals?
questions.explanation: God made all the animals! He made big ones and tiny ones, and each one is special (Genesis 1:25).

questions.question: What do plants need to grow?
questions.explanation: Plants need water and sunshine to grow. God sends the rain and sunshine to help them (Genesis 1:11).

questions.question: What did God put in the sky to give us light during the day?
questions.explanation: God made the sun to give us light during the day and keep us warm (Genesis 1:16).

questions.question: Why is water important?
options: We need it to drink and plants need it to grow
questions.explanation: Water is very important! We drink water, animals drink water, and plants need water to grow. God gives us water because He loves us.

questions.question: How many senses did God give us?
questions.explanation: God gave us five senses: sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch! We are wonderfully made (Psalm 139:14).
